title: Have WTAP_ERR_INTERNAL include an err_info string giving details.
description:
That way, users won't just see "You got an internal error", the details
will be given, so they can report them in a bug.

commits_data.title: Have WTAP_ERR_INTERNAL include an err_info string giving details.
commits_data.message:
Have WTAP_ERR_INTERNAL include an err_info string giving details.

That way, users won't just see "You got an internal error", the details
will be given, so they can report them in a bug.
